01 / Getting started

From first call
to reporting in.

You’ll work with a recruiter. Availability, requirements and rental terms depend on the area and assignment.

  1. 01
    Step one

    Tell us where you can work

    Share your city or area and the days and times you are available. Mention whether you already have a vehicle.

  2. 02
    Step two

    Discuss the opening

    The recruiter can explain the reporting point, shift and vehicle requirements and which documents to bring for verification.

  3. 03
    Step three

    Complete onboarding

    Follow the recruiter’s instructions to verify your details, confirm your company assignment and, if agreed, collect a rental EV.

  4. 04
    Step four

    Confirm your first shift

    Before you set off, confirm the reporting time, hub contact and pickup point.
